text:
Harper Mills: Quick idea \u2014 tiny PLG playlet next week: short launch post + 12-min ignite demo + tiered credit ladder to nudge prompt-template trials. keep cohort ~350.
Diego Fontana: sounds good. single-sentence hypothesis?
Harper Mills: demo exposure + a curated prompt pack after signup -> higher 7-day template adoption vs credits-only. credits remove friction.
Rina Shah: suggest 3 arms, N=350: (A) demo + $20 milestone credit on attend, (B) $10 read-credit only, (C) control (post only). 10-day run.
Clara Jensen: routing rules? need to decide how inbound gets bucketed and cap demo seats.
Diego Fontana: propose: utm_medium=ignite -> auto A, paid-social -> randomize A/B, organic -> randomize across all arms. cap demo seats at 220/week. overflow -> waitlist + $5 consolation.
Rina Shah: onboarding change: show a 3-card "ignite prompt pack" for demo attendees with one-click run. Product flag name: mkt/ignite_pack_v1. canary to 40 users.
ops-bot: created feature flag mkt/ignite_pack_v1 (canary=40) :white_check_mark:
Clara Jensen: email cadence for demo arm: invite, -48h reminder, -1h reminder, replay + redeem link. replay should include a one-click "Try this prompt" CTA.
Harper Mills: metrics: day1_template_try_pct, week1_retention, time_to_first_api_call_median, redemption_rate. will also collect a 1-question NPS after demo.
Diego Fontana: events I'll track: post_view, post_read, demo_invited, demo_rsvp, demo_attended, pack_shown, template_ran, credit_claimed, first_api_call.
Rina Shah: draft experiment config below, ack with :thumbsup: if ready.
```yaml
experiment_id: ignite_playlet_196543
cohort: 350
arms:
  - name: demo_plus_milestone
    demo_invite: true
    milestone_credit_usd: 20
  - name: read_credit
    demo_invite: false
    milestone_credit_usd: 10
  - name: control
    demo_invite: false
    milestone_credit_usd: 0
metrics:
  - day1_template_try_pct
  - week1_retention
  - time_to_first_api_call_median
traffic_rules:
  - if: utm_medium==ignite -> assign:demo_plus_milestone
  - if: source==paid_social -> random_assign(demo_plus_milestone, read_credit)
  - else: random_assign(all_arms)
```
Clara Jensen: owners: landing & post copy = Harper, slides + demo = Diego, emails = Rina, FF + onboarding push = product/infra, analytics = Diego, credits ops = @finance-ops.
Harper Mills: timeline: landing + copy by Mon EOD, flag canary + QA Tue AM, launch Wed AM. small runbook 15-min Tue 9:30.
Rina Shah: tagging @finance-ops to confirm credit provisioning and anti-abuse checks.
Diego Fontana: I'll wire dashboard and add a 48h early-signal alert for template_try_rate.
Harper Mills: final note \u2014 keep messaging concise: "12-min ignite demo + $20 when you attend." any objections?
Clara Jensen: :thumbsup:
Rina Shah: :thumbsup:
Diego Fontana: :thumbsup:
Harper Mills: great, booking runbook. :rocket:
